$comment: AUDIT of coordinates whose only ratification comes from a minimal MULTI-coordinate witness. A holding 2-set is guaranteed minimal — checkWitness raises NOT_MINIMAL when either coordinate alone already collides the stimuli — so for every coordinate here the harness has positively established that erasing it ALONE does not destroy the distinction. That is the retention criterion failing, and `ratifiedSet` was reading it as passing. What such a witness does prove is that the SEMANTIC DISTINCTION is real; what stays open is the factorization. The earlier witness record is deliberately NOT altered: stage 1.5 adjudicated under the older rule and closed, and rewriting a finished experiment's result from outside it is the thing this slice refuses everywhere else. The question is asked here instead.

dispositions.unresolved: not yet adjudicated; the close condition is zero of these
dispositions.witnessed: a holding witness in witnesses.json ratifies it against the frozen oracle
dispositions.representation-artifact: erasing it cannot collapse two representations, because another coordinate already carries the distinction; the census measured the encoding rather than a degree of freedom
dispositions.not-yet-admitted: no active authority requires the distinction it names; it leaves the kernel with the earliest stage allowed to re-earn it
dispositions.required-derived-vocabulary: no independent semantic degree of freedom — it is wholly derivable from other semantic facts — but external authority governs the NAME, so the coordinate legitimately stays in the kernel. The only decided verdict that does not expect the coordinate to disappear.

outcomes.$comment: The three ways an entry can resolve. Naming them in advance keeps the audit from defaulting to the most convenient one.
outcomes.bothReEarned: each coordinate has its own holding single-coordinate falsifier; the 2-set was incidental, and both are primitive
outcomes.onePrimitiveOneDerived: one carrier holds the degree of freedom and the other is derivable from it — required derived vocabulary, or a representation artifact
outcomes.compositeePrimitive: neither is primitive in its current form: the semantic primitive is a composite the schema decomposed into two mutually dependent coordinates. A semantic distinction can be irreducible while every coordinate in its current encoding is reducible

basis.reason: the commit at which primitive ratification was separated from interaction evidence, which is what made this population visible; measured, not enumerated by hand
